scene_status.note: Stored 3D scene heads and pending proposals, not an execution grant, render result or final-output approval. requires_review means the shot context or project ontology changed since that version or pending proposal was saved, so approval or rendering will be refused. Pending proposals are proposed/held ones based on the current head; stale_total counts older ones that can no longer be approved. head 0 means no approved version: its first draft is reviewed in Scene Studio and change proposals need base_revision equal to a head of 1 or more. Lists keep the latest 32 scenes and 10 pending proposals per scene; *_total and *_truncated report omissions. Approval and rendering stay human actions in Scene Studio.
